record_info.statute: Cal. Fin. Code Div. 1.2 (Money Transmission Act), secs. 2010, 2030-2040

license_required.quote: A person shall not engage in the business of money transmission in this state

bond_structure.quote: in an amount greater than the average daily outstanding obligations for money received for transmission in California
bond_structure.note: For receiving money for transmission (2037(e)): more than average daily outstanding obligations, floor $250,000, cap $7,000,000. Sellers of payment instruments or stored value have a separate, cumulative $500,000 to $2,000,000 requirement (2037(d)).

bond_min_usd.quote: shall not be less than two hundred fifty thousand dollars ($250,000)

bond_max_usd.quote: nor more than seven million dollars ($7,000,000)

net_worth_structure.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000)
net_worth_structure.note: 3% / 2% / 0.5% by asset bracket, same structure as Texas and Delaware; commissioner may exempt (2040(b))

net_worth_min_usd.quote: a tangible net worth of the greater of one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000)

application_fee_usd.quote: a nonrefundable fee of five thousand dollars ($5,000)

renewal_fee_usd.quote: a licensee fee of two thousand five hundred dollars ($2,500)
renewal_fee_usd.note: Annual licensee fee due by July 1; California licenses do not expire, so this is the recurring fee

decision_days.quote: the commissioner shall approve the application
decision_days.note: No deadline to approve or deny in the statute

exemptions.quote: This division does not apply to any of the following:
exemptions.note: (k) is not a separate exemption; it limits (d). Agents of licensees are exempt through 2030(a).
